selection: Pooled WAPE on the last eight fit origins; train on preceding fit origins; ties prefer earlier candidate. Refit on all fit origins. No development/test tuning.
statistical_refitting: At every forecast origin, fit the selected fixed statistical model on its most recent 56 observed days; select no orders or types on test targets.
input_policy: seasonal_naive/ets/sarima: history only; ridge/xgboost: same history plus permitted future factors and deterministic dates; no Open/price/availability or future sales features
